blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 雷森布尔通过将形状和布置分开,从单X射线上重建8根腰骨和盆骨. 每个3D查询在其图像投影时都对区域和全球特征进行抽样. 一个共享的解码器预测正常的骨骼形状. 预测的深度和相机几何决定了3D中枢和尺度,将这些形状以毫米的方式重印到共同的网格上. 评价使用23个持有43个CT扫描的停机病人,每个病人产生一个模拟的Anterposefore射电图. 不与CT僵硬对齐,雷瑟姆布勒领先15种评价方法,平均65.24%的Dice,9.09毫米HD95,以及3.32毫米ASSD超过3个随机种子. 由于投入相同,Dice比VolumeNERF提高了5.86个百分点.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: From a single anteroposterior (AP) radiograph, we aim to recover the surfaces, physical sizes, and relative positions of L1–L5, the sacrum, and both hip bones (Fig. a). Similar projected outlines can conceal different depths, cone-beam magnification couples depth and apparent size, and lumbar and pelvic structures overlap in the image (Fig. b). Recovering this anatomy requires both local bone detail and the spatial relationships among bones.
blocks.zh: 从一幅单角射电图中,我们的目标是收复L1-L5的表面,体积和相对位置,即圣体和双臀骨(图a. 相类似的被预测的轮廓可以隐藏出不同的深度,圆锥束放大对等的深度和明显的大小,以及图像中的lum和骨盆结构相重叠(图. b). 恢复这个解剖学需要局部的骨分和骨间的空间关系.

blocks.en: Methods that reconstruct a 3D volume from X-rays predict anatomy on a common grid [ 24 , 12 , 1 ] . Statistical shape models constrain the range of plausible anatomy [ 25 , 15 ] . A normalized bone shape can occur at different positions and physical sizes. Raysemble uses this distinction to estimate shape and placement separately, with camera geometry relating depth to magnification.
blocks.zh: 从X射线上重建出3D体积的方法预测出一个共同网格上的解剖[24,12,1]. 统计形状模型制约了可能解剖的范围[25,15]. 正常的骨形可以在不同的位置和物理大小上发生. Raysemble利用这种区分来分别估计形状和位置,相机几何与放大相相接.

blocks.en: The two branches meet during assembly (Fig. c). An initial placement positions the 3D queries used to reconstruct each bone. Each query is projected once to sample features from both the bone crop and the full image, preserving local detail and anatomical context. A shared decoder predicts occupancy on a normalized grid. The final placement branch estimates depth, back-projects bone centers, and adjusts scale for magnification. Resampling combines the decoded shape with the predicted center and scale on a common grid in millimeters (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 两分会场在组装期间相会(图c. 初始放置位置是用于重建每个骨骼的3D查询. 每一次查询都预测从骨稼和完整图像中抽取特征,保留局部细节和解剖上下文. 共享解码器预测在正格网上的占用. 最终投放分支估计出深度,后期项目骨骼中心,并调整规模以进行放大. 复标将解码外形与以毫米(图2 )为单位的普通网格上所预测的中心和尺度相融合.

blocks.en: We compare 15 configurations before alignment and test Raysemble against VolumeNeRF with identical images, probability maps, bone regions, and camera parameters. Raysemble leads on Dice, HD95, and ASSD. A fixed-shape comparison isolates the mean improvement from final placement, while separate evaluations examine rigid alignment and exploratory real pelvic radiographs.
blocks.zh: 我们用相同的图像、概率图、骨骼区域以及相机参数来比较15个配置,然后将Raysemble与VolumeNERF进行比较。 Raysemble在Dice,HD95和ASSD上领先. 固定形状的比较将平均改善与最后安置隔离开来,而单独的评价则审查刚性对接和探索性真正的盆腔放射图。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: X2CT-GAN synthesizes CT from two orthogonal radiographs, and SAX-NeRF reconstructs radiodensity from sparse projections [ 24 , 3 ] . With a single radiograph, Henzler et al. first predict a coarse CT volume and then use the input image to refine it [ 8 ] . VolumeNeRF conditions CT synthesis on an anatomical likelihood, while XctDiff uses priors extracted from the radiograph to guide latent diffusion [ 12 , 1 ] . These methods target an entire volume of CT intensities. To obtain bone labels, we pair the synthesized volume with a segmenter. Our matched-input comparison tests this route against predicting bone occupancy directly.
blocks.zh: X2CT-GAN从两个正向放射图中合成了CT,而SAX-NERF则从稀有的预测中重建出放射性密度[24,3]. 以单幅放射图,Henzler等首先预测出粗糙的CT体积,再用输入图像来细化它[8]. VolumeNERF在解剖可能性上为CT合成提供了条件,而XctDiff则使用从放射图中提取的先质来引导潜在扩散[12, 1]. 这些方法针对的是整个CT强度. 为了获得骨头标签,我们把合成的体积与分片相配. 我们的匹配输入比较 测试这条路线 与预测的骨头占用直接。

blocks.en: Zheng uses landmark-to-ray correspondences to initialize pelvic pose and scale, then iteratively fits a statistical shape model to the projected contours [ 25 ] . The study estimates unknown model scales by matching the reconstructed surface to its CT reference. Joint 2D–3D SSM learns a shared PCA space for deformations of 2D masks and 3D shapes, allowing it to infer the 3D deformation from a 2D observation [ 15 ] . 3DDX instead predicts depths for the front and back surfaces, uses the camera geometry to reconstruct an initial surface, and fits a statistical shape model to complete it [ 5 ] . X2V and X2BR represent organ and bone geometry, respectively, with implicit fields [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 郑用地标对射的对应来初始化骨盆姿势和尺度,再迭接地将统计形状模型与预测轮廓相匹配 [25]. 该研究通过将重建的地表与其CT参考物相匹配来估计未知的模型尺度. Joint 2D–3D SSM为2D口罩和3D外形的变形而学习了共享的PCA空间,使其能从2D观测中推断出3D变形[15]. 3DDX取而代之,预测了前后地表的深度,用相机几何来重建出一个初始地表,并适合统计形状模型来完成[5]. XV和X2BR分别代表器官和骨几何,并有隐含字段[6,7].

blocks.en: A second view provides complementary anatomical evidence. Lin et al. reconstruct multiple leg bones from biplanar X-rays, and X2Bone fuses AP and lateral views to reconstruct the pelvis [ 11 , 14 ] . For a single AP view, Raysemble must infer each bone’s depth from the image and learned anatomical relationships. It predicts bone shape on a normalized grid and estimates the center and scale separately for assembly.
blocks.zh: 第二种观点提供了补充解剖学证据。 林等编. 由双子座X光再重建多条腿骨,而X2Bone将AP和平面视图接上来再重建骨盆[11,14]. 对于单一的AP观点,雷森布尔必须从图像中推断出每个骨骼的深度,并学会解剖关系. 它在正统的网格上预测出骨骼形状,并分别估计集合的中心和尺度.

blocks.en: PIFu samples image features at projected 3D points [ 16 ] . DISN combines local samples with a global image descriptor, and PIFuHD uses features from a coarser stage to guide fine prediction [ 23 , 17 ] . For sparse-view CBCT, C 2 RV combines features across scales and views [ 10 ] . Raysemble projects a query into a single AP image, then samples two spatial feature maps at that point. The crop provides detail around the target bone, and the full-image map preserves the surrounding anatomy.
blocks.zh: PIFu在预测出3D点的图像特征样本 [16]. DISN将局部样本与全局图像描述符结合,而PIFuHD则使用从相近相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 对于稀有的CBCT,C2 RV结合了跨尺度和视图的特征[10]. Raysemble将一个查询投放到一个单一的AP图像中,然后在那个点上取出两个空间地物图样本. 作物提供目标骨周围的细节,完整的图像图保存了周围的解剖学.

blocks.en: Object reconstruction also uses normalized coordinates to separate shape from placement. NOCS estimates pixel correspondences to a shared object coordinate system and uses measured depth to recover metric pose and size [ 20 ] . In our setting, the image center specifies a ray through the X-ray source. Raysemble estimates depth along that ray to place the bone center, then uses the change in magnification to adjust its scale. This separation lets us test placement changes with the decoded bone shapes held fixed.
blocks.zh: 对象重建还使用正态坐标将外形与放置相分离. NOCS对共享对象坐标系统进行像素对应估计,并使用所测量的深度来恢复公尺的姿势和大小 [20]. 在我们的设定中,图像中心指定一个射线穿过X射线源. Raysemble估计出沿着那道射线的深度来放置骨骼中心,然后利用放大的变化来调整其尺度. 这种分离让我们测试用固定的已解码的骨骼形状进行放置变化.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: Each seed has three stages of 60 epochs, each covering eligible samples once. We first train the autoencoder on normalized CT masks. With its decoder frozen, we train the image encoders, shape predictor, and initial placement. Supervision covers local occupancy, latent codes, mask overlap in physical space, projected silhouettes, and relative depth. We then freeze the shape predictor and train final placement using center, log side length, mask overlap, and silhouettes, emphasizing bones with larger initial center errors. Absolute depth prediction is introduced over the first five epochs.
blocks.zh: 每个种子有三个阶段60个纪元,每个纪元覆盖一次合格的样品. 我们首先在普通的CT口罩上训练自动编码器. 它的解码器被冻结, 我们训练图像编码器,形状预测器, 和初始位置。 监督范围包括当地占用、潜在代码、外罩在物理空间上的重叠、所预测的淤泥和相对深度。 然后,我们冻结形状预测器,并使用中心、记录侧长、口罩重叠和硅胶来训练最后放置,强调有较大初始中心错误的骨头。 在前五个纪元中引入了绝对深度预测.

blocks.en: We use 419 CT scans from 225 subjects in the CT-TRI and AbdomenCT-1K subsets of CADS [ 22 , 13 ] . We generate one digitally reconstructed AP radiograph (DRR) per scan with DiffDRR [ 4 ] using fixed cone-beam geometry. The training, validation, and test splits contain 338, 38, and 43 scans from 180, 22, and 23 subjects, respectively. We keep all scans from a subject in the same split. The test set contains 34 CT-TRI and nine AbdomenCT-1K scans. We use TotalSegmentator [ 21 ] to generate the reference masks and map them to the eight target bone labels. We screen scans for label presence, bone volume, field of view, and metal artifacts (Supplementary Sec. S1 ).

blocks.en: We report Dice, the symmetric 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and average symmetric surface distance (ASSD). For the main comparison, we score the predictions before alignment to CT and measure distances in millimeters on the fixed RAS grid. We first average over the eight bones, then over each patient’s scans, and finally across patients with equal weights. In a separate comparison, we align the entire reconstruction to CT using rotation and translation only. If a reference bone is missing from the prediction, we assign a Dice score of zero and use the grid diagonal for both distance metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们报告Dice,对称的95%Husdorff距离(HD95)和平均对称的地表距离(ASSD). 为了进行主要比较,我们在与CT对接之前先得分,并在固定的RAS网格上以毫米测量距离. 我们首先平均在8个骨骼上, 然后是每个病人的扫描, 最后是同等重量的病人。 在单独比较中,我们只使用旋转和翻译来将整个重建与CT对齐. 如果在预测中缺少一个参考骨,我们分配出一个零分的Dice分数,并使用网格对角来进行两个距离度量.

blocks.en: The direct baseline broadcasts 2D features into a 3D U-Net. Projection-to-volume adaptations include Henzler [ 8 ] , PatRecon [ 18 ] , XctNet [ 19 ] , XctDiff [ 1 ] , and VolumeNeRF [ 12 ] . Bone- and shape-centered adaptations include 3DDX-Direct [ 5 ] , X2V [ 6 ] , X2B [ 7 ] , SR-Net [ 9 ] , RT-SRTS [ 26 ] , Joint 2D–3D SSM [ 15 ] , and SSR/PIFu [ 16 , 11 ] . We adapt each method to use one AP view and predict eight bone labels. Each trainable stage runs for 60 epochs. Supplementary Table S1 lists inputs, supervision, adaptations, training stages, and checkpoint selection for all 15 configurations.
blocks.zh: 直接基准广播2D功能为3D U-Net. Projection- to-world readition包括亨兹勒 [8],帕特雷康 [18],XctNet [19],XctDiff [1],和VolumeNERF [12]. 以骨骼和外形为中心的适应包括:3DDX-Direct [5],X2V [6],X2B [7],SR-Net [9],RT-SRTS [26],联合2D–3D SSM [15],和SSSR/PIFu [16,11]. 我们调整了每一种方法,以使用一个AP视图,并预测出8个骨头标签. 每个可被训练的舞台运行60个世纪. 补充表S1列出了所有15个配置的投入、监督、调整、培训阶段和检查站选择。

The models use crops from the radiographs and nominal camera settings. blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The two branches address different ambiguities in Fig. b. Sampling local and full-frame features connects each bone to the surrounding anatomy. Separating normalized shape from placement makes it possible to update center and scale without changing the decoded surface. The advantage over matched VolumeNeRF persists after rigid alignment, which preserves differences in local shape, physical size, and relative bone positions.

blocks.en: The matched-input experiment compares direct bone reconstruction with CT synthesis followed by segmentation. The same segmenter reaches 91.82% Dice on reference CT and 59.38% on synthesized CT, and both pipelines predict all eight bones (Supplementary Sec. S5 ). Within Raysemble, fixed-shape placement improves the mean reconstruction scores, although confidence intervals include zero. AP center error decreases with little change in scale error. Shape pretraining ablations also change the mean latent code and its supervision.
blocks.zh: 匹配输入实验将直接骨骼重建与CT合成相比较,再进行分解. 同一分管器在参考CT上达到91.82%的Dice,在合成CT上达到59.38%的Dice,而两个管线都预测出所有8个骨骼(补充Sec. S5. ). 在Raysemble内部,固定形状的布置能改善平均重建分数,尽管信心间隔包括0. AP中心出错随着规模出错的微小变化而减少. 形状预演会也会改变最小的潜在代码及其监督.

blocks.en: Clinical evaluation before alignment requires calibrated camera geometry and confirmed image pairs. Magnification errors can be mistaken for bone-size errors. FleXray’s public training sources omit CT-TRI and AbdomenCT-1K, but patient-level independence requires identifiers absent from those records (Supplementary Sec. S1 ). Truncated bones can displace the predicted ROI and the initial query grid, affecting both feature samples. Assembly preserves normalized bone orientation. Clinical measurements require independently annotated references.
blocks.zh: 对齐前的临床评价需要校正相机几何和确认的图像对. 放大错误可以被误认为是骨大小错误. FleXray的公共培训来源省略了CT-TRI和AbdomenCT-1K,但病人一级的独立要求这些记录中缺少识别资料(补充Sec. S1)。 断头骨可以取代所预测的ROI和初始查询网格,影响两个特征样本. 组装保持了正常的骨质取向. 临床测量需要独立的注释参考。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Raysemble separates bone shape from physical placement to reconstruct eight bones from one AP radiograph. The same projected query samples local and full-frame features, and depth-dependent magnification links the predicted center to scale. Resampling assembles the bones on a common 3D grid. Raysemble leads the 15-configuration comparison before alignment and retains its matched-input advantage after rigid alignment.
blocks.zh: 雷相会将骨骼外形从物理放置中分出来,从一个AP无线电图中重建出8个骨骼. 相同的预测的查询样本局部和全帧特征,和深度依赖放大将预测的中心相接而成的规模. 复能将骨头装入普通的3D网格上. Raysemble在对齐前领先于15个配置比较,并保留了刚性对齐后对应投入的优势.

blocks.en: The NIfTI affine maps CT voxel centers to RAS. To find the isocenter, we resample the CT toward 4 mm spacing and identify the body with a − 500 -500 HU threshold. In the central half of the body width and the posterior 60% of its AP span, we count voxels above 250 HU and smooth the superior–inferior profile with a 15 mm Gaussian. A 400 mm window starts at the lower end of this profile. Lung and upper lumbar intensities can shorten the window at its upper end. We take the midpoint of the window, shift it 8 mm caudally, and use the body midline and the center of the posterior band for the other coordinates. When high-density counts are unavailable, we use the body-count profile. We use automatic labels to screen scans, train the models, and evaluate predictions.
blocks.zh: NIfTI的外观将CT voxel中心映射到RAS. 为了找到异位点,我们把CT重新做成4毫米相距,并用-500-500HU阈值识别出身体. 在体宽的中半部和AP的后半部的60%,我们计算出超过250HU的活塞,并且用15毫米高斯琴来平滑的上等-下等轮廓. 一个400毫米的窗口从这个配置图的下端开始. 肺部和上部的收缩能缩短其上端的窗口. 我们取出窗口的中点, 将它弯曲地转出8毫米, 并使用身体中线 和后波段的中心 其他坐标。 当高密度的计数不可用时,我们使用体数剖面. 我们使用自动标签来筛选扫描,训练模型,并评价预测.

We then subtract the isocenter from the translation in the crop affine. DiffDRR [ 4 ] loads the cropped CT in AP orientation with volume recentering disabled ( center_volume=False ) and resamples it to 1 mm isotropic spacing. We use its HU-to-density conversion with a bone attenuation multiplier of 6.0. Rendering uses patch_size=128 . The source is fixed at ( 0 , 1050 , 0 ) (0,1050,0) mm, and the 450 × 450 450\times 450 mm detector lies at d = − 150 d=-150 mm; yaw, pitch, and roll are all zero. At the native 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution, detector pixel spacing is 0.439453125 mm. We clip each DRR at its 1st and 99th intensity percentiles, map it to 8-bit grayscale, and bilinearly resize it to 512 × 512 512\times 512 without padding. The benchmark uses the raw DRRs. The fixed isocenter field of view is 393.75 × 393.75 393.75\times 393.75 mm.

blocks.en: Each configuration produced 129 predictions (43 scans and three seeds), each evaluated on eight present reference bones. A missing bone receives Dice zero and the physical grid diagonal (about 800 mm) for both distance metrics. Table S4 reports the incidence. Both input-matched VolumeNeRF and Raysemble predicted all eight bone classes in every saved output. Their large-distance cases therefore contain spatial or shape errors even when all labels are present.

blocks.en: For this check, we apply the same frozen segmenter from each matched VolumeNeRF checkpoint to the held-out reference CT. On the same grid and with equal weights per patient, it achieves 91.82 ± 0.31 91.82\pm 0.31 % Dice, 4.59 ± 0.20 4.59\pm 0.20 mm HD95, and 0.76 ± 0.03 0.76\pm 0.03 mm ASSD across seeds. Its agreement with the reference labels is higher on acquired CT than on synthesized CT. The difference reflects both the synthesized volume and the segmenter’s response to it.
